title: Canon File
description: The single record of true campaign facts. Rule: if a fact is not here, the fact is not true. See AI DM Operating Guide, Section 1.

last_session_written.description: Number of the last session fully written to this file. Operating Guide 11.3: do not end a session before this file is updated.

last_clock_touched.description: Name of the villain clock touched in the last session. Operating Guide 4.3. Null only before session 1.

villains.description: Part A: Villains and their clocks. Operating Guide Section 2.

trait.description: One trait players will remember. Checklist 2.5.

escape_plan.description: How this villain escapes capture. Checklist 2.4.

clocks.description: Each clock is one quest toward the goal. Checklist 2.3. A campaign should give each villain up to three.

segments_total.description: Operating Guide 2.2: a clock has 4, 6, or 8 segments.

status.description: 'complete' means segments_filled reached segments_total. Operating Guide 2.7-2.8: tell the players the result.

threads.description: Part B: Open threads. Operating Guide Section 3. Do not keep more than five open (3.7).

staleness_count.description: Sessions since this thread last appeared in play. At 2, put it back into play (3.4). At 3, the world acts on it without the players (3.5).

facts.description: Part C: Established facts. Canon-level improv items go here at the moment they are stated (Operating Guide 5.4-5.7).

source.description: 'DM' or the name of the player who established this fact.

characters.description: Part D: Characters and their abilities, as recorded canon (not the full mechanical sheet, which lives in characters/*.json).

items.description: Part E: Items and rewards given.

promises.description: Part F: Promises made to players.

rulings.description: Part G: Rulings made. Operating Guide 7.2: write each ruling here. 7.7: a ruling changes only for a new in-story fact or a canon-file error.

secret.description: Operating Guide 12.1-12.4: this file holds secret information. Do not show its contents to players.
